== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-3706]] is assessed at 85% (probable). The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms index entry for John Glasgow, 6 July 1786 at Eccles, Berwickshire (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/27458592), reads the parent fields that the previous review could not see: father Robert and mother Agnes (forenames only). The previous 49% rested only on a handed-down family tree that quotes no record. John's birth date 6 July 1786 is exactly this entry, and the index shows one Robert and Agnes family at Eccles (which includes Leitholm) from 1779 to 1795: James 1779, Thomas 1781, Marion 1782, William 1784, John 1786, Agnes 1789, Thomas 1791 and Isobel 1795 (for example https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/27458082). That is the household of Robert [[Glasgow-3706]] and Agnes Whitehead, who married at Leitholm in 1779. Confidence rises from 49% to 85% probable.

The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms rows are Ancestry's copy of the FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms index already cited, so they verify the indexed parent fields rather than adding an independent source; the original register is uninspected. The index row gives the mother's forename only; Whitehead comes from the couple's 1779 marriage. John's later identity as the Leitholm man who died in 1864 rests on his profile's birth date and residence. Robert-3706's own father link (James-1238, 34%) is separate and unchanged. No mother change follows.
